meta.name: PSYREN
meta.description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he's drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.

videos.title: Urban Legend
videos.overview: High school student Ageha finds a mysterious telephone card in a phone booth.

videos.title: Tavoo
videos.overview: The Psyren game begins. Ageha must protect Amamiya in a world overrun by monsters.

videos.title: PSI
videos.overview: Ageha and his friends have ended up in a death game. While heading for the finish line, before they can make it to safety, an unworldly monster calls a Taboo appears before them.

videos.title: Recall
videos.overview: In a bid for survival, Ageha undergoes PSI training. Meanwhile, the actor Oboro and opportunistic Kabuto also receive phone cards.

videos.title: Those Gathered
videos.overview: A giant monster appears in the Psyren world where Ageha and the other Drifters have been teleported. Then, it turns out that the person standing in their path is Hiryu’s close friend, Tatsuo.

videos.title: Memory
videos.overview: Unless they defeat Tatsuo, they won't make it to the goal. Ageha and Hiryu launch an attack on him together.
